title: wg: room-policy-04 §6.2 JoinLinksUpdate index semantics unspecified
description: Suggestion. removedIndices and added_links (L700-703) don't say whether indices refer to the pre- or post-update list, or whether removals or appends apply first. The result enters the GroupContext, so divergent members fork. mimid applies removals first with pre-update indices (decision mimid-1wgh.3.19). Fix: specify the order.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED: JoinLinksUpdate index semantics. New issue (pair with protocol 37.48).

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-room-policy/issues/30
